description: Presentation data for Documentation → AI Agents & Tools. Agent names, versions, tools and connections must match api/config/intake-agent.json, api/config/recommendation-agent.json and api/config/portfolio-agent.json.
hostedIn: All three agents run in the Microsoft Foundry project pmo-portfolio on foundry-myaacoub-private, using gpt-5.6-sol. The API calls them with its managed identity.
routing: OneLake tool calls leave Foundry through the private Azure API Management gateway (MCP). Bing grounding is a Foundry-managed tool, so its calls do not pass through APIM.

agents.name: pmo-intake-agent
agents.trigger: Data entry, Quick add: enter a project name and a plain-English description, then choose Pre-fill with AI (Missing only).
agents.description: Reads the project name, the description, and any uploaded documents, then fills each project field it can ground in public sources. Each value carries an evidence level, a quote, a rationale, and the source URL it came from. Anything the agent cannot support stays empty for a person to complete.

tools.name: Bing grounding
tools.purpose: Searches the public web so that skills, sites, effort, and cost ranges come from sources rather than guesses.

agents.name: pmo-recommendation-agent
agents.trigger: AI Recommendations page: it runs when the page opens, when the portfolio filter changes, and for each research question.
agents.description: Recommends genuinely new opportunities and prioritizes only confirmed not-started projects. Started, on-hold and completed work stays protected. It reads the full project register, including pending entries, to compare proposed work with existing names and scope. People approve every new project or decision, and the API rechecks eligibility and duplicate names before saving.

tools.name: query_portfolio
tools.purpose: Ranks confirmed not-started candidates, searches the full register for duplicates (including pending, started and completed work), and reads budgets and skill supply/demand. Queries are read-only and bounded.

tools.name: Bing grounding
tools.purpose: Checks public context for each new project opportunity.

agents.name: pmo-portfolio-copilot
agents.trigger: AI Copilot button, available on every page.
agents.description: Answers questions about the approved portfolio using OneLake data only. Each answer lists the project IDs it used, and the API rejects any project the tool did not return.

tools.name: query_portfolio
tools.purpose: Returns exact rankings, filtered project lists, budget totals, and skill capacity, with truncation flags so answers never extrapolate.
